title: Meters
description: See each meter's lifetime total and current session value. Lifetime totals include readings outside sessions.
empty: No meters yet. Create one, then report values through this resource's flows.
name: Meter name
error: Unable to save the meter. Check that no active meter has this name and try again.
rateHint: 0 disables billing. The rate is captured when a session starts.
archiveMessage: The meter moves to Archived meters and is no longer measured or billed for new sessions. Its history and pending charges are kept. Flow nodes that use it are marked invalid and their reports fail until you choose another meter or restore this one. You can restore it later.
deleteMessage: This meter has never recorded anything. Flow nodes that use it become invalid until you choose another meter. This cannot be undone.
errorInUse: A running session uses this meter. Try again after the session has ended.
errorInUseDelete: A running session uses this meter, so it cannot be deleted now. Try again after the session has ended. If the meter has recorded values by then, archive it instead.
errorHasHistory: This meter has recorded history and cannot be deleted. Archive it instead.
errorNameExists: An active meter already has this name. Rename one of the two first.
errorAction: Unable to change the meter. Try again.
emptyActive: No active meters. Create one, or restore an archived meter.
missing: The chosen meter was archived or deleted. Choose another one.
